articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: France, England play for third place; Messi, Brady in KD's all-star selfie
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the World Cup as we decide who finishes in third place between England and France.

articles.headline: Future of hydration breaks undecided - FIFA's Arsène Wenger
France vs. England: Thomas Tuchel names Ivan Toney in much-changed World Cup team
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has made seven changes to the England team that lost the World Cup semifinal against France on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Spain-Argentina World Cup final last-minute tickets start at $10,000
articles.description: Last-minute tickets to see Lionel Messi and Argentina face off against Lamine Yamal and Spain in the FIFA World Cup final range from $10,000 to $60,000.

articles.headline: Storms expected to clear wildfire smoke ahead of World Cup final
articles.description: Smoke from the Canadian wildfires that has engulfed the Northeast in haze is expected to mostly clear from the New Jersey area just in time for the World Cup final on Sunday, thanks to thunderstorms passing through the area, meteorologists say.

articles.headline: Argentina's Emiliano Martínez admits playing with pain of broken finger
articles.description: Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano "Dibu" Martínez admitted he's been playing through pain in his right hand throughout the World Cup after avoiding a recommended operation in order to participate in the tournament.
